adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly adds `Post.cook_methods` with `:raw_html` and changes `Post#cook` to `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. `TopicEmbed.import` and `import_remote` ingest remote HTML (RSS `i.content` / Readability `doc.content`) and create posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and the embed view renders it via `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. This makes untrusted remote HTML effectively stored/displayed without sanitization, creating a stored-XSS risk wherever `cooked` is rendered.
